name: calendar
purpose: Date-range picker. A trigger button opens a popover that holds a month grid, Start/End date + time fields (suppressible with `show-fields`), an optional timezone selector, and an Apply action; it also offers a "Select Period" mode whose hint chips and typed text are read in the active locale (`45m`, `12 hours` / `12 horas`, `last month` / `mês passado`, `yesterday` / `ontem`, `1/1 - 1/2`). When consumer-provided `presets` are supplied, the trigger splits into two side-by-side segments — a preset dropdown (left, `🕐 <label> ⌄`) that applies a preset range in one click, and the calendar (right, `📅 <range>`) that opens the grid for fine-tuning. Selection is staged in a draft inside the popover and committed to `v-model` only on Apply (or immediately when `show-apply` is false); a preset commits immediately. In period mode, once a span is applied the trigger shows the same two-segment shape — the relative token (e.g. `45m`) beside the concrete window it resolves to (e.g. `14:44 – 23:59`) — since a period selects a time interval rather than whole days. Date math uses the native `Date` API only — no date library; timezone is a selectable IANA label used for display formatting via `Intl` (the picker does not re-interpret `Date` objects across zones).
useWhen: Picking a date range for analytics, logs, or billing windows, optionally with times and a timezone.
Offering one-click ranges ("Last 7 days") next to the grid through `presets`.
Relative time windows typed as text (`45m`, `last month`) with `period`.
avoidWhen: Only a fixed list of named windows, with no custom range → use `select`.
A duration or count (retention days, TTL) rather than a date → use `number-input`.
related: select` — a fixed list of named periods without a grid.
input` — the trigger and the Start/End fields share its heights, hover, and disabled treatment, so they align side by side.
number-input` — numeric durations instead of dates.
bestPractices: modelValue` is committed only on Apply; read the final value from `update:modelValue` or `apply`, and set `:show-apply="false"` when every edit should commit at once.
Bind a `{ start, end }` object in range mode and a `Date` or `null` with `mode="single"`.
Bound the selectable days with `min` and `max` instead of validating after commit.
Pair `show-timezone` with `v-model:timezone`; the timezone changes display formatting only, not the `Date` values.
Prefer the `presets` prop; use the `presets` slot with `Calendar.Preset` only when preset content needs custom markup.

props.name: modelValue
props.doc: Committed selection for v-model. A `Date` (or null) in single mode; a `{ start, end }` range in range mode. Only updated on Apply (or immediately when `showApply` is false).

props.name: mode
props.doc: Selection mode. Single picks one date; range picks a start and end date.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects the trigger, day-cell hit-area, and typography.

props.name: min
props.doc: Earliest selectable date; earlier days render disabled.

props.name: max
props.doc: Latest selectable date; later days render disabled.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the trigger, grid, and all controls, applying disabled tokens.

props.name: open
props.doc: Controlled open state of the popover. Use with v-model:open; omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Trigger text shown when there is no selection. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Select a date range`).

props.name: presets
props.doc: Consumer-provided shortcuts; each is `{ label, value }` where value is a `Date` or range. When present, the trigger becomes a two-part control whose left segment opens a dropdown of these presets.

props.name: showFields
props.doc: Shows the Start/End date fields in the panel. Set false when the shortcuts and the grid are the whole interaction and typing a boundary by hand is not offered.

props.name: showTime
props.doc: Shows Start/End time fields alongside the date fields.

props.name: showTimezone
props.doc: Shows the timezone selector below the fields.

props.name: timezone
props.doc: Selected IANA timezone for display formatting (v-model:timezone). Empty resolves to the local zone.

props.name: timezones
props.doc: Timezone options for the selector; empty falls back to a curated list derived from `Intl`.

props.name: horizontal
props.doc: Lays the fields/apply column beside the calendar instead of below it.

props.name: clearable
props.doc: Shows a clear control on the trigger that empties the committed selection.

props.name: showApply
props.doc: Stages edits in a draft and requires Apply to commit; when false, every edit commits immediately.

props.name: period
props.doc: Enables the "Select period" relative-time mode: a relative-preset list plus a text input that parses spans like `45m` or `last month`.

props.name: split
props.doc: Renders the trigger as a split control with a separate chevron affordance.

events.name: update:modelValue
events.notes: v-model. The committed `Date` (single) or `{ start, end }` (range); empty value on clear.

events.name: update:open
events.notes: v-model:open. Emitted when the popover opens or closes.

events.name: update:timezone
events.notes: v-model:timezone. Emitted when the timezone selection changes.

events.name: month-change
events.notes: Emitted when the first visible month changes via navigation or keyboard paging. Payload is `{ year, month }` (month is 0-indexed).

events.name: apply
events.notes: Emitted when the draft selection is committed via Apply.

slots.name: trigger
slots.notes: Replaces the default trigger button; scope exposes the open state, raw value, and formatted label.

slots.name: presets
slots.notes: Custom preset dropdown content (e.g. `<Calendar.Preset>`); overrides the `presets` prop rendering.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  import Calendar from '@aziontech/webkit/calendar'

  const range = ref(null)
</script>

<template>
  <Calendar
    v-model="range"
    mode="range"
    clearable
    show-time
    show-timezone
  />
</template>
